Final Total Points Band.instructions: Forecast the combined final points for Atlanta and Green Bay from the supplied halftime evidence, including first-half points and any overtime. Use the ordered bands with indices 0 through 4. The returned score is a probability-weighted band index and may be fractional; it is not a predicted point total. Return the probabilities for all five bands. The application will sum the probabilities for indices 2, 3, and 4 to calculate the chance of strictly more than 40 total points; exactly 40 belongs to index 1.
criteria: Under 30: The combined final score is fewer than 30 points, including any overtime (index 0).
30-40: The combined final score is 30 through 40 points, including any overtime (index 1).
41-49: The combined final score is 41 through 49 points, including any overtime (index 2).
50-59: The combined final score is 50 through 59 points, including any overtime (index 3).
60 or More: The combined final score is at least 60 points, including any overtime (index 4).
